subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` type remain as a deprecated type-only Plugin SDK compatibility export until a declared major-version removal window?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically retain the alias, but maintaining or ending a shipped external SDK contract requires an explicit maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
options.body: Restore the exported alias while keeping the retired runtime config key invalid and document its future removal boundary.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK removal
options.body: Keep the deletion only with explicit maintainer confirmation that this release intentionally breaks external plugin TypeScript builds.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
recommendation.body: Restore the exported alias while keeping the retired runtime config key invalid and document its future removal boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history and PR context place this configuration and SDK-surface proposal with steipete.
